intro: Isi pax dan tarikh berlepas / balik — panjang trip, peak season dan semua surcharge dikira sendiri dan terus masuk dalam harga per pax. Harga asas = harga katalog (Aceh 4D3N dari RM1,097 · Aceh+Sabang 5D4N dari RM1,457); diskaun Selling Tier 2 (−RM200/pax) TIDAK dikira di sini — tolak sendiri kalau quote guna Tier 2. Hari tambahan / kurang: rate card beri satu kadar rata semua-dalam (+RM90/pax/hari untuk tambah, −RM50/pax/hari untuk kurang) yang sudah meliputi hotel, transport dan aktiviti — jadi transport hari tambahan tidak dicaj berasingan. Upgrade hotel: 4 bintang +RM50/pax/malam, 5 bintang +RM90/pax/malam, dikenakan hanya pada malam Banda Aceh (Freddies Sabang kekal 3 bintang).

16 pax ke atas: rate card hanya senaraikan kenderaan sehingga 15 pax — sahkan bilangan kenderaan dengan Ops, kalkulator kira 1 kenderaan sahaja.
Tier 26 pax ke atas: harga adult dari Product Cheatsheet 2026 (Price Tier 4); harga kanak-kanak tidak tersiar untuk tier ini — kalkulator guna harga kanak-kanak tier 11–25, sahkan dengan Ops.
41 pax ke atas: Aceh+Sabang 5D4N tiada tier yang sah (rate card tulis RM1,017, lebih rendah daripada tier 26–40 — nampak salah taip). Kalkulator guna tier 26–40; sebut harga dengan operator.

validity: Prices are based on the PT Aceh 4D3N and PT Aceh + Sabang 5D4N 2026 catalogues last updated 8 December 2025 and are valid for travel until 31 January 2027; departures from 1 February 2027 must be requoted. This quotation is valid for 24 hours. A deposit of RM250 per person is due on confirmation and full payment 45 days before departure. A late booking surcharge of RM50 per booking applies to bookings made less than 45 days before departure. Prices are for 2 to 3 persons per room; a proper bed for triple sharing and family rooms are available at 4-Star hotels only, subject to availability, while 3-Star hotels use an extra rollaway bed. Private transportation, driver and tour guide are on a 12 hours basis; extra hours are charged at 150,000 IDR per hour, payable in cash to the driver. The final itinerary and hotel arrangements are confirmed 14 days before the trip. The dolphin trip and the Ulee Lheu - Balohan ferry crossing are subject to weather and sea conditions.
